name: Roo Code
desc: Open-source VS Code agent with switchable modes
desc_zh: 可在多种模式间切换的开源 VS Code 智能体
solves: Planning, writing, and debugging are different jobs, and one agent rarely does all three well. The mode switches between them.
solves_zh: 规划、写代码、排查问题是三种活，一个智能体通常做不好全部三件。模式在其中切换。
best_for: When you want an open-source agent in VS Code whose behaviour follows the task.
best_for_zh: 当你想在 VS Code 里用一个开源智能体，并希望它按任务类型改变行为时。
